mapper.sql: booking_id, order_no, entry_code, member_id, session_id, status, seat_no, lock_expires_at, reminder_opt_in, source, plan_code, plan_name, amount, member_name, member_phone, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volt_booking WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT FROM volt_booking WHERE member_phone = #{phone} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND status IN ('locked', 'confirmed') LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM volt_booking WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND status IN ('locked', 'confirmed') LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volt_booking WHERE member_phone = #{phone} AND plan_code = 'PLAN-01' AND status IN ('locked', 'confirmed', 'checked-in')
SELECT FROM volt_booking WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, booking_id DESC
SELECT FROM volt_booking WHERE member_phone = #{phone} ORDER BY created_at DESC, booking_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volt_booking (booking_id, order_no, entry_code, member_id, session_id, status, seat_no, lock_expires_at, reminder_opt_in, source, plan_code, plan_name, amount, member_name, member_phone, created_at) VALUES (#{bookingId}, #{orderNo}, #{entryCode}, #{memberId}, #{sessionId}, #{status}, #{seatNo}, #{lockExpiresAt}, #{reminderOptIn}, #{source}, #{planCode}, #{planName}, #{amount}, #{memberName}, #{memberPhone}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE volt_booking SET status = 'confirmed', lock_expires_at = NULL WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND status = 'locked'
UPDATE volt_booking SET status = 'cancelled', lock_expires_at = NULL WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND status IN ('locked', 'confirmed')
UPDATE volt_booking SET status = 'checked-in' WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND status = 'confirmed'
